page.layout: One page of text, single column of dictionary entries mixing Latin with Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac script; no margin notes. Running head centred at top; page number at top left; signature mark at foot.

main_text.p: להב Syr. Vapor, ענן Nisi vapor, Jac.4.14.
להט Flammare. Pahel להט Inflammare, Accendere.
להן Ch. Quamobrem, Itaque, Dan.2.6.9. Nisi, praeterquam, Dan.6.6. & sic idem quod אלהן.
לא Syr. Idem quod לא Non: Nonne, Annon, Numquid? לא Et non, Neque.
לוה Ch. Adhaerere, adjungere se alicui, comitari, conducere, deducere aliquem. Pahel לוי
Ch. & Syr. Idem. Aphel אלוי Idem. Ex Ethpah. Praet. Qui deduxerunt Paulu, Act.17.15.
Syr. Comitatus. Lucae 2.44. Filii comitatus ejus, id est Comites, Act.19.29.
לויא, לוי Ch. Butyrum, Jobi 26.17. & 29.6. Deuter.32. 14. in Targ.Jon.
ליואה Ch. Syr. Levita. Plur. ליואי, & ליא.
לוי לויאי לוי Ch. Si: Utinam, Hebr. לו. Nonnunquam praeponitur הלויאי: sic quandoque ipsi subjungitur פון, ut Jos.7.7.
לוג Ch. Sextarius, mensura liquidorum minima, vigesimaquarta pars Seae sive Sati, sex ova continens.
לודי לוד Ch. Lydius. Plur. Const. לודאי. Foem. Lydia, Act.16.14.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac characters are reproduced only approximately; the scan is faint and the Syriac and Hebrew vowel points could not be read with certainty, so these entries are marked as doubtful in their Hebrew/Syriac forms. Several Syriac words are illegible in detail.
